meta.title: Licensed employer, posting refuses sponsorship outright

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer — Data Platform
Farrowgate Analytics Ltd · London (hybrid, 2 days in office)

Farrowgate Analytics builds forecasting tools used by UK grocery chains to cut waste in fresh-food ordering. Our platform team is eight engineers; you would join the ingestion squad.

What you'll work on
- Python services that pull EPOS feeds from 200+ stores nightly
- Data-quality checks that block bad feeds before they reach forecasting
- Migrating our oldest pipelines from cron to our internal scheduler

You should have 1-3 years of experience with Python and SQL, and enough curiosity to chase a data discrepancy to its source.

Salary is £41,000 plus 5% bonus. 25 days holiday. Please note: we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Applications close 12 September.

expected.determining_fact: Farrowgate Analytics Ltd is a licensed Skilled Worker sponsor, but this requisition explicitly excludes sponsorship.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position

design_notes: The holding-a-licence-vs-using-it archetype. Every register signal is green; only the posting text blocks it. A solver that checks the register and stops issues a false SPONSORABLE.
